basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old college student currently exploring the vast world of Reddit. I hail from the sunny coasts of California, where I spend most of my time studying sociology and playing video games. I'm still figuring out what kind of content I enjoy the most, but I have a keen interest in human behavior and racial dynamics. I work part-time as a barista, and I'm single, enjoying the freedom to explore different perspectives and hobbies. My typical online hours are late evenings, as I juggle between school, work, and gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational understanding of sociology from my college courses, which sparked my interest in racial and cultural dynamics. Most of my insights are further expanded through online discussions and articles I find intriguing. I'm also a self-taught gamer, having spent countless hours on platforms like DayZ and exploring narratives in Tom Clancy games.
